title: Snooze, Removal and Calendar Block Terms by Space Type (Roamhaven Listings)
content:
# Snooze, Removal and Calendar Block Terms by Space Type

*Host Support quick reference for Roamhaven Listings.*

| Space type | Snoozing or unlisting leaves confirmed stays in place | A listing with confirmed, checked-in or requested stays cannot be removed | A removed listing can be relisted | Nights of a stay the host cancels are blocked on the calendar | Nights the host-cancellation block covers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shared Room | yes | yes | no | yes | every night of the cancelled stay |
| Private Room | yes | yes | no | yes | every night of the cancelled stay |
| Entire Guest Suite | yes | yes | no | yes | every night of the cancelled stay |
| Entire Apartment | yes | yes | no | yes | every night of the cancelled stay |
| Entire Home | yes | yes | no | yes | every night of the cancelled stay |
| Luxury Villa | yes | yes | no | yes | every night of the cancelled stay |

## The same terms, column by column

- **Confirmed stays survive a snooze or an unlisting.** For all six space types, snoozing or unlisting leaves confirmed stays in place.
- **Open stays block removal.** For all six space types, a listing that has a confirmed, checked-in or requested stay cannot be removed.
- **Removal is final.** For no space type can a removed listing be relisted.
- **Host cancellations block the calendar.** For all six space types, the nights of a stay the host cancels are blocked on the listing's calendar, and the block covers every night of the cancelled stay.
